title: Private Oahu Food & Farm-Focused Tour | Up to 10 Guests
includes: Tastings, alcohol flights, farm tours, admission fees, and paid experiences (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This private Oʻahu food and farm-focused tour is designed for guests who want their day built around local flavors, North Shore stops, coffee, cacao, macadamia nuts, pineapple treats, local shops, and island-style food options — without joining a crowded bus tour or fixed group itinerary.

Your group travels together in a private, climate-controlled Mercedes-Benz Sprinter van with a professional driver/host who helps manage timing, route flow, and pickup/drop-off logistics. This is a customizable route, so stops may be adjusted based on your interests, pickup location, traffic, business hours, lunch plans, and any optional paid experiences requested in advance.

Guests may have time to visit local food, farm, shopping, and tasting-style stops such as Waialua, Haleʻiwa, North Shore macadamia nut shops, Dole Plantation, and other route-friendly locations. Meals, drinks, tastings, alcohol flights, farm tours, admission fees, and paid activities are not included unless arranged separately.
